Submission Description: (doc-less) Motion to Intervene of Michigan Attorney General under ER26-3650-000.

Submission Date:        9/18/2026 10:44:13 AM

Filed Date:             9/18/2026 10:44:13 AM

Dockets
-------
ER26-3650-000        Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-08-28_Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads submitted on 8/28/2026 4:41:03 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Michigan Attorney General                moodym2@michigan.gov                                                             

Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rule 214 of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s (FERC or Commission) Rules of Practice and Procedure, Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, on behalf of the people of the State of Michigan, seeks to intervene as a party in the docket.  The Michigan Attorney General, on behalf of the people of the State of Michigan, moves to intervene in this proceeding. (MCL 14.28 (“The attorney general . . . may, when in [her] own judgment the interests of the state require it, intervene in and appear for the people of this state in any other court or tribunal, in any cause or matter, civil or criminal, in which the people of this state may be a party or interested.”). The People of the State of Michigan have a direct interest in the outcome of this proceeding as the households and businesses of Michigan may impact electricity bills and the electric grid as a result of the Midcontinent Independent System Operator's proposed tariff revisions in this proceeding.
